question: What fraction of real paraphrase contamination does wai.decontaminate() remove from a training set, and what does it cost in clean rows?
ground_truth: human-labelled paraphrase pairs: QQP (nyu-mll/glue, qqp) duplicates and PAWS (labeled_final); leaks carry a task_id from a different namespace than the holdout, so the same_task rule cannot fire
compute: CPU only; 3 seeds x 2175 rows lexical, 1450 rows for the semantic threshold sweep
model: offline (no model keys present); BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 used only as the embedder= for the semantic rule

semantic_cost_seconds.note: decontaminate()'s semantic pass is quadratic in rows and not vectorised: ~4x per doubling
